mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0% for three consecutive months, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered periods, or Rank IC for the signal is below 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in nonfarm payrolls signals robust labor market conditions that boost corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of UNRATE decline and PAYEMS increase fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of instances, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 4.0% YoY), rising residential sales (RSAFS) signals resilient consumer demand that offsets inflation concerns, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In CPIAUCSL > 4.0% YoY periods, RSAFS rise fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or signal Rank IC < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls over the past three months indicates robust labor market strength that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS increases, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 98.0% of its 12-month moving average, it signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate profitability expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered periods, or signal Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and rise in consumer inflation signals weakening housing demand amid inflationary pressures, increasing equity risk premiums and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST decline and CPIAUCSL rise fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In a slowing economic growth regime (GDPC1 quarterly growth < 1.0%), a decline in industrial production signals deepening supply-side contraction that reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In GDPC1 growth < 1.0% periods, INDPRO decline fails to produce negative 5-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or signal Rank IC < 0.02.
